model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: A fresh re-execution replaces no historical bytes: prior unavailable attempts and their notifications remain separate. Shared host/instructional isolation, acquisition/cache timing and unknown resolved models/native usage limit comparison. The optional native Control Panel Appearance-tab route was not verified; settings/default state restoration and reload were checked separately. Only sampled motion frames were viewed, with no natural-speed playback, complete motion-suppression, physical keyboard, screen-reader, other-browser, fault-injection or human-preference claim. Reported load bytes/timing are single local observations, not a performance benchmark.
